description: This source file defines an OpenMeterLogger class for logging cost and usage data to an external OpenMeter API endpoint. It includes methods for environment validation, logging success events synchronously and asynchronously, and internal logic for constructing log data. It interacts with other modules such as litellm, custom_logger, and custom_httpx.

classes.name: OpenMeterLogger
classes.description: A logger class for sending cost and event data to the OpenMeter monitoring service via synchronous and asynchronous HTTP requests.

methods.name: get_utc_datetime()
methods.description: Returns the current UTC datetime, handling potential differences in Python environment.

methods.name: validate_environment(self)
methods.description: Checks for required environment variables 'OPENMETER_API_ENDPOINT' and 'OPENMETER_API_KEY', raising an exception if missing.

methods.name: _common_logic(self, kwargs: dict, response_obj)
methods.description: Constructs the event data payload including usage details, user identification, and metadata, for logging.

methods.name: log_success_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Sends a synchronous HTTP POST request to log a successful event with the constructed data payload.

methods.name: async_log_success_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Asynchronously sends a POST request to log an event with the prepared data payload.
